title: Verified product usage restrictions do not reach creative model calls

evidence.note: Host passes only verified raw/hash/query. Generator consumes brief/cards, losing source restrictions. Four actual VideoStudio integration cases first fail.

trigger_path: G1 passed source restrictions -> verifiedRaw without restrictions -> creative/insight/PRD model calls ignore original use limits -> final gate rejects late

assertions.given: Real model adapter interfaces including native vendor prototype bridge, direct and routed transports, concurrent task scopes, complete source restrictions
assertions.expect: Every call receives the full source restrictions; custom system prompt cannot omit them; unrelated/narrative/concurrent runs do not inherit them; malformed limits and overflow stop rather than truncate.

fix_plan: Bind full restriction list hash to raw hash in host-only verified input; validate before vendor construction; AsyncLocalStorage scope appends full limits to all adapter interfaces including vendor-owned engines. Final source qualification remains independent.
blast_radius: Marketing native model input and attested host config; no manual creative decisions, vendor mutation, media retry, source profile changes or added fact authority.
rollback: Revert scoped source restriction propagation; preserve native facts and original archives; do not reuse downstream qualification.
notes: MC008 restriction qualification remains, MC010 ensures generator consumes limits before creative work. Prompt propagation is not proof that every generated claim complies; final system review still required.
